commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Aaron Escandell comes off his line to intercept the corner from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
90+7' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play and Rayo Vallecano manage to earn a corner.
90+6' Rayo Vallecano are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
90+4' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
90+4' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Rayo Vallecano will take a corner kick.
90+3' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+2' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) makes an ugly tackle on his opponent and is sent off by the referee!

90+1' The Rayo Vallecano players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Rayo Vallecano.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' The resulting corner, taken by Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo), comes to nothing.

90' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Oviedo.
90' An attempted cross from Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) is cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Oviedo.
86' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Oscar Valentin.

85' Substitution. Isi Palazon will be replaced by Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano).

82' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes a short corner kick.

79' It's time for a substitution. Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) comes on in place of Leander Dendoncker.

78' That was absolutely fantastic! Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the crossbar! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.

61' A pass into the penalty area from Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by the defence.

58' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Aaron Escandell, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
57' Here is a change. Nobel Mendy is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano).
56' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
53' We have witnessed a red card for Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo).
53' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! A free kick has been awarded to Rayo Vallecano.

53' Pablo Agudin (Real Oviedo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Quintero saw the whole situation. The referee gives a penalty to Rayo Vallecano after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
52' Shots on target – 3:1.

48' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

39' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rayo Vallecano.

33' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Quintero signals a set piece. Oviedo have a free kick.
33' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

33' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Augusto Batalla! Oviedo get a corner.
32' Leander Dendoncker (Real Oviedo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

31' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the right side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
31' It should have been a goal! Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
31' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) will take the free kick.
29' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
29' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) jumps into a tackle and Alejandro Quintero signals a foul.
28' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

27' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner.
26' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) attempts to release Ilyas Chaira with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
24' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
24' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 53:47.

21' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) watches the cross in from Pep Chavarria, but plants his header from the edge of the six-yard box well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Oviedo will have a goal kick.
21' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
18' Looks like Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
18' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Salomon Rondon (Real Oviedo) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
16' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
14' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
12' The Oviedo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
12' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
10' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
8' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul and Alejandro Quintero immediately signals a free kick. Oviedo win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
7' The free kick is delivered by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
6' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul. Rayo Vallecano are awarded the free kick.
5' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
2' Great teamplay by Rayo Vallecano as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
